HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #3
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

2. Which response best shows understanding of Path of Action? (1 mark)
   A. Use Path of Action to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Path of Action.
   C. Apply the teaching of Path of Action with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Path of Action has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Fundamental Principles ,? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Fundamental Principles ,.
   B. Say Fundamental Principles , has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Fundamental Principles , with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Fundamental Principles , to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Protocols in Sanatan Dharma Circumbulation? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Protocols in Sanatan Dharma Circumbulation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Protocols in Sanatan Dharma Circumbulation.
   C. Use Protocols in Sanatan Dharma Circumbulation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Protocols in Sanatan Dharma Circumbulation has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Religious Ceremonies? (1 mark)
   A. Say Religious Ceremonies has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Religious Ceremonies.
   C. Apply the teaching of Religious Ceremonies with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Religious Ceremonies to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Which response best shows understanding of ● Sukhmani Sahib 9-16 Ashtpadi? (1 mark)
   A. Use ● Sukhmani Sahib 9-16 Ashtpadi to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say ● Sukhmani Sahib 9-16 Ashtpadi has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of ● Sukhmani Sahib 9-16 Ashtpadi with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing ● Sukhmani Sahib 9-16 Ashtpadi.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Scriptural Texts ● Yajur Ved: Sangathan mantra ● Uttradhyan Sutra Chapter 19- 21? (1 mark)
   A. Say Scriptural Texts ● Yajur Ved: Sangathan mantra ● Uttradhyan Sutra Chapter 19- 21 has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Scriptural Texts ● Yajur Ved: Sangathan mantra ● Uttradhyan Sutra Chapter 19- 21.
   C. Use Scriptural Texts ● Yajur Ved: Sangathan mantra ● Uttradhyan Sutra Chapter 19- 21 to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Scriptural Texts ● Yajur Ved: Sangathan mantra ● Uttradhyan Sutra Chapter 19- 21 with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Buddhist Sanskaars? (1 mark)
   A. Say Buddhist Sanskaars has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Buddhist Sanskaars.
   C. Use Buddhist Sanskaars to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Buddhist Sanskaars with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Destroy trees without planting

10. Which response best shows understanding of Protocols in Jain Dharma Aarti and Mangal Divo,? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Protocols in Jain Dharma Aarti and Mangal Divo,.
   B. Use Protocols in Jain Dharma Aarti and Mangal Divo, to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Protocols in Jain Dharma Aarti and Mangal Divo, has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Protocols in Jain Dharma Aarti and Mangal Divo, with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

12. Which response best shows understanding of Buddhist Principles of Dharma Noble Eightfold Path? (1 mark)
   A. Say Buddhist Principles of Dharma Noble Eightfold Path has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Buddhist Principles of Dharma Noble Eightfold Path to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Buddhist Principles of Dharma Noble Eightfold Path.
   D. Apply the teaching of Buddhist Principles of Dharma Noble Eightfold Path with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Religious Ceremonies and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Buddhist Sanskaars and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Scriptural Texts ● Yajur Ved: Sangathan mantra ● Uttradhyan Sutra Chapter 19- 21 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Path of Action and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Religious Ceremonies and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
